verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 58.3 (-5.7% in a day) and momentum is 43: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,900 and 86s 5,900. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-26T12:31:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Jude Bellingham 90 after its 21% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 57,000 coins. Now 62,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 21.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 9 of 17 so far, averaging +9.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Debinha 88 Team of the week after its 31% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 57,500 coins. Now 19,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 30.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 14 of 23 so far, averaging +6.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,900 (1.38 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,900 (1.44 coins per Item Score point), 87s 8,200 (1.49 coins per Item Score point), 88s 14,000 (1.69 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: David Raya and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: David Raya 89 Team of the week -85.4%; Mohamed Salah 88 Team of the week -84.2%; Marquinhos 88 Team of the week -83.0%; Florian Wirtz 87 Team of the week -82.2%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
